answer: An adversary hence has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 28 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The wander counter is kept in zephyr and lagoon reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 28 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 1678 identities would post 2487 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
